2026-08-10 11:21:06.019146 | controller | The unit files have no installation config (WantedBy=, RequiredBy=, UpheldBy=,
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019176 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019192 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019197 | controller |
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019205 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019211 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019214 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019218 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019222 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019226 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-10 11:21:06.019229 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
